web_evidence.title: Theatre by W. Somerset Maugham, from Project Gutenberg Canada
web_evidence.note: The complete library ebook spans Chapter I through the final Chapter XXIX. Opening, middle, and closing scenes consistently narrate Julia, Michael, and other characters externally in third person while entering their thoughts; visible first person is confined to dialogue, letters, or direct thought, with no sustained alternate narrator.

search_log: Searched “Somerset Maugham Theatre novel excerpt first chapter Julia Lambert” and full-text/archive variants; found and inspected the complete Project Gutenberg Canada ebook across opening, interior, and final chapters.

Searched “Theatre Somerset Maugham point of view,” “third-person narrator,” “omniscient narrator,” “narrative voice,” and “focalization”; secondary results discussed Julia’s internal monologue but rarely named grammatical person explicitly.

Searched for “Theatre Somerset Maugham epistolary,” “multiple narrators,” “alternating point of view,” and “first person narrator”; found no evidence of epistolary construction, alternating base sections, or a participating narrator.

Checked Penguin Random House, Penguin UK, Google Books, Open Library, and Internet Archive records; they verified the work and Julia-centered plot but their catalog or promotional descriptions were not treated as person evidence.

Checked Graham Wolfe’s Routledge chapter metadata and university/scholarly results concerning Maugham’s narration; accessible metadata did not explicitly establish this novel’s narrative person and was not used as supporting evidence.
person_note: The diagnostic Goodreads passages repeatedly expose a nonparticipating narrator describing Julia and entering her consciousness in third person. The complete Project Gutenberg Canada text independently shows the same form from the opening through Chapter XXIX. First-person material is confined to character speech, letters, or direct thought, and q00082’s “you” is Roger addressing Julia rather than second-person narration. No sustained contrary section or frame was found; the only limitation is the scarcity of explicit secondary POV descriptions.
